items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the vehicle tax assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post. Statutory delivery rule under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (not the '4th day' claimed in the letter, see warning) deems a postally sent administrative act delivered on the third day after posting. Counting from 20.11.2026 (day 0, not counted): 21.11 (Sat), 22.11 (Sun), 23.11 (Mon) = 3rd day → Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) on Monday 23.11.2026; this day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so it stands. The one-month Einspruchsfrist under §355 Abs. 1 AO then runs per §108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §§187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: it ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or statutory holiday in NRW (24.12. is not a statutory holiday), so the deadline stands at 23.12.2026.

items.title: Automatic debit of the annual vehicle tax
items.quote: Den Betrag buchen wir vom angegebenen Konto ab.
items.computation: The letter states the tax of 146,00 € will be debited automatically from the account on file ('vom angegebenen Konto'), but gives no specific calendar date for this debit, so no exact due date can be computed; the tax period itself starts on the registration date 02.11.2026 and runs for one year.

warnings: The letter's Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung states that a letter sent by post is deemed delivered on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after posting; the correct statutory rule under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO for German tax authority mail is the third day after posting, not the fourth — this discrepancy was flagged and the legally correct 3-day rule was used to compute the deadline, which lowers confidence in the exact due date.

No exact date is given for when the automatic account debit of 146,00 € will occur; only the bank name 'Landesmusterbank' and an IBAN are shown in the footer, not tied to a specific debit date — verify with the Hauptzollamt or your bank statement when the debit actually happens.
